blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — More than 6,000 employment opportunities were offered to jobseekers in three cities in Eastern Visayas through a series of job fairs organized by the Office of Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian in partnership with the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE). The Tacloban leg of the employment caravan was held Saturday, Oct. 10, at the Tacloban Convention Center, where more than 2,600 job opportunities were made available to applicants seeking work in local and overseas companies. A total of 31 local establishments and three overseas companies participated in the whole-day event, giving jobseekers an opportunity to apply for available […]...
